control_name: Access provisioning is approved before grant
control_objective: Every grant of access to a financially-significant application is authorized by an appropriate approver before the access is provisioned, so that only properly authorized users can transact.
risk_addressed: Unauthorized or excessive access to financially-significant systems allows fraudulent or erroneous transactions to bypass the control environment, misstating the financial statements.

required_data_elements.business_definition: A provisioning event granting a user a role/entitlement on an in-scope system.
The approved access-request ticket authorizing the grant.

method.summary: Reconcile every in-scope provisioning event to an approved access request dated on or before the grant.
steps: Pull all grant events for in-scope systems in the period from the IAM source.
Pull approved access-request tickets from ITSM.
Match each grant to an approval with approval timestamp <= grant timestamp.
Count grants with no matching prior approval (exceptions).
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any unapproved grant to a financially-significant system is a control exception.

pass_criteria: 100% of in-scope grants trace to a prior approval.
Approval evidence captured for the population.
fail_criteria: One or more grants lack a prior approval.
exception_handling: Remediate access and re-test before relying on the control.

assertions.description: No in-scope grants without a prior approval.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.

actions_on_fail: Notify IT Security Manager and Controller
